slots.title: Discover menu tile — Scientific Research (low-key, v2)
slots.prompt: Low-key documentary photograph, square format, of a Black male research scientist in his fifties looking into the eyepieces of a binocular laboratory microscope. Close cropped greying hair and a neatly trimmed greying beard, calm and absorbed in the work, wearing a white lab coat over a dark collared shirt. He is seen from the front and slightly to the side, his head and shoulders filling the right half of the frame and angled down toward the eyepieces. The microscope stands in the left foreground, its dark body catching one cool rim highlight. The laboratory behind him is dark and falls away into deep graphite shadow, colour #1A1A1A, almost black at the edges of the frame, with only a few faint cool highlights suggesting glassware. A single hard cool key light from the left picks out his brow, cheekbone and the eyepieces and falls off steeply, leaving the right side of his face and the whole background in shadow. Deep blacks, restrained highlights, moody and serious rather than bright and clinical. Shallow depth of field so only his eye and the eyepieces are critically sharp. 85mm lens at f2, natural skin tones, cool desaturated grade, high contrast, editorial reportage.
